sci_fi_hard.craft: maintainable aerospace structures, practical cabin point lights, worn titanium, reflective spacesuits, instrument displays, cold controlled contrast, physically plausible floating dust
sci_fi_hard.avoid: neon cyberpunk pollution, holographic UI clutter, cybernetic bodies, rain-soaked neon streets, purple/magenta light pollution as default future
sci_fi_hard.camera_bias: Favor medium, close, and close-up. Use wide only for true scale of space architecture.
sci_fi_hard.soundscape: mechanical cabin hum, soft suit fabric, distant instrument beeps, controlled air recirculation

sci_fi_opera.craft: monumental minimalist brutalist architecture, vast negative space, solemn natural light, weathered stone, heavy matte metal, protective fabrics, dry drifting dust
sci_fi_opera.avoid: cheap neon cyberpunk shorthand, cluttered holograms, cartoon proportions
sci_fi_opera.camera_bias: Wide only when monumental architecture or fleet scale is the story; otherwise medium and close for faces.
sci_fi_opera.soundscape: vast hall reverb, distant boots on stone, low wind across plaza, solemn quiet between lines

sci_fi_wasteland.visual_style: Live-action, cinematic, wasteland relic science fiction
sci_fi_wasteland.craft: eroded technological ruins, harsh daylight, sand-scattered particles, rusted steel, weathered armor, worn leather, cracked surfaces, restrained dusty earth tones
sci_fi_wasteland.avoid: clean chrome utopia, neon cyberpunk nights, glossy VFX-first look
sci_fi_wasteland.camera_bias: Eye-level and low angles emphasizing isolation; wide for ruin scale when needed.
sci_fi_wasteland.soundscape: wind over sand, metal creak, distant debris, dry fabric and boot grit

sci_fi_alien.craft: internally consistent organic architecture, plants and fungi, wet surfaces, translucent veins, water droplets, keratin scales, refraction, localized soft biological light only on living organisms
sci_fi_alien.avoid: city neon cyberpunk, generic green goo tropes, overlit bioluminescence flooding the frame
sci_fi_alien.camera_bias: Push-ins and tracking through wet organic corridors; macro for texture, medium for characters.
sci_fi_alien.soundscape: wet drip, soft organic membrane stretch, distant creature breath, humid air

micro_expression.craft: tight facial close-up, readable eye/brow/mouth micro-changes, shallow depth of field, skin texture retained, performance-first framing
micro_expression.avoid: wide establishing unless briefly motivated, busy background action stealing focus, over-smoothed plastic skin
micro_expression.camera_bias: Close-up and extreme close-up; subtle push-in on emotional beats.
micro_expression.soundscape: quiet room tone, breath, subtle fabric, clear dialogue when present

product_minimal.craft: clean negative space, precise product silhouette, controlled studio key and soft rim, material truth (metal, glass, fabric), slow confident camera
product_minimal.avoid: busy lifestyle clutter, neon cyberpunk, cartoon CGI look, unreadable logo distortion
product_minimal.camera_bias: Macro and medium hero angles; slow orbit or push-in.
product_minimal.soundscape: soft studio hush, tactile material SFX on contact, no busy street bed

title_sequence.craft: graphic composition, timed title reveals, strong silhouettes, editorial pacing, controlled typography moments only when intended as on-screen titles
title_sequence.avoid: random watermark text, unreadable typography, slideshow of unrelated shots
title_sequence.camera_bias: Motivated moves that land on title cards or iconic objects.
title_sequence.soundscape: stylized impacts synced to cuts, sparse atmosphere

handdrawn_live.visual_style: Hand-drawn live hybrid, ink and paper texture over photographic staging
handdrawn_live.craft: visible line work, paper grain, controlled color fill, live-action blocking translated into drawn performance
handdrawn_live.avoid: pure photoreal skin lock, generic anime sakuga unless requested, plastic 3D CGI
handdrawn_live.camera_bias: Medium and close with drawn parallax; keep motion readable.
handdrawn_live.soundscape: paper rustle accents optional, clear dialogue, light ambient

cgi_short.craft: PBR materials, coherent lighting, appealing proportions, clear silhouette animation, feature-trailer energy without plastic toy look
cgi_short.avoid: live-action skin claims, low-poly game leftovers, noisy cyberpunk neon default
cgi_short.camera_bias: Cinematic lenses with motivated moves; hold hero poses.
cgi_short.soundscape: designed Foley matching CGI materials, clear dialogue if any

music_video_cool.visual_style: Live-action music-video cool, rhythmic graphic frames
music_video_cool.craft: bold lighting accents, rhythmic camera energy, stylized wardrobe, graphic negative space, cut-friendly end frames
music_video_cool.avoid: forced dialogue lip-sync unless requested, random cyberpunk clutter without beat motivation
music_video_cool.camera_bias: Tracking and handheld pulses timed to imagined beat; punch-ins on peaks.
music_video_cool.soundscape: diegetic room / crowd only if needed; primary song muxed later
